subject: Recovery proof request: incremental KV-cache snapshots & failback runbook
messages:
From: Lucia Ramos <lucia.ramos@everoak.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: ops@everoak.com
Date: Tue, 15 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: artifacts for RTO/RPO verification on Redwood integration

Hi Sean,

As part of our procurement security review, we need concrete artifacts that demonstrate Redwood's recovery characteristics for the integration pattern we discussed (incremental KV-cache warm start + failback). Specifically we'd like the following by next Wednesday if possible:

- A daily RTO/RPO snapshot export for the last 30 days (or the most recent export you have). CSV or JSON is fine.
- KV-cache warm-start trace for a standard failover sequence (timestamped logs).
- The failback runbook (the exact runbook steps that ops would execute).
- A short agenda for a 45-minute live-witness session to validate warm-start timings and restore behavior.

Also let us know whether the artifacts can be shared via a secure S3 pre-signed URL or a shared Drive link with limited access.

We are targeting an internal review on Apr 24 and would prefer a witness session before that.

Thanks — Lucia
Lucia Ramos
Head of Vendor Risk | Everoak Financial

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
To: Lucia Ramos <lucia.ramos@everoak.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Apr 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: artifacts for RTO/RPO verification on Redwood integration

Hi Lucia — thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble the artifacts and propose a witness slot. Quick notes:

- We can export the last 30 days of RTO/RPO snapshots; filename format will be rto_rpo_snapshot_YYYYMMDD.csv.
- KV-cache warm traces are sensitive (contain operation timestamps). We'll provide a sanitized log (kv_cache_warm_log_YYYYMMDD.json) with redactions; raw traces are available under NDA if needed.
- The failback runbook is currently in PDF (runbook_failback_v2.pdf).
- Proposed witness windows (PT): Apr 22 10:00–10:45, Apr 23 15:00–15:45. Please tell us which works best.

Irene — can you pull the April 14 snapshot and the warm-cache trace, redact any IPs, and stage to a secure Drive folder? Kimberly — once Irene confirms, please draft a short agenda (live_witness_agenda.docx) and an operations checklist for the session.

Lucia — are presigned S3 links acceptable, or do you prefer Drive? We can do either and will lock access to the Everoak domain.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Lucia Ramos <lucia.ramos@everoak.com>, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Apr 2025 08:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: artifacts for RTO/RPO verification on Redwood integration

On Tue, Apr 15, 2025 at 11:03 AM, sean_gallagher@redwood.com wrote:
> I re: Proposed witness windows (PT): Apr 22 10:00–10:45, Apr 23 15:00–15:45.

Hi Lucia — attaching the artifacts we discussed. Links are locked to everoak.com and will expire in 14 days. If you need extended access let us know and we'll open a short-term extension.

Attachments (stubs):
- rto_rpo_snapshot_20250414.csv (30-day export: columns = date, region, observed_rto_ms, observed_rpo_s)
- kv_cache_warm_log_20250414.json (sanitized: timestamps preserved; agent hostnames redacted)
- runbook_failback_v2.pdf (Ops runbook, step-by-step failback and verification checks)
- live_witness_agenda.docx (45-min agenda with attack/scenario matrix)

Shared links: https://drive.redwood.com/everoak/BCP/2025/q2/snapshots (access: everoak@everoak.com)

Short summary of key metrics pulled from the snapshot:
- Average observed warm-start RTO (multi-region) = 28s
- 95th percentile RTO during warm-start = 72s
- Observed RPO events in last 30 days = 0 (application writes use synchronous persistence to primary store)

We will plan to use Apr 23 15:00–15:45 PT for the live witness unless you confirm the 22nd.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Sr. Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Lucia Ramos <lucia.ramos@everoak.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Apr 2025 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: artifacts for RTO/RPO verification on Redwood integration

Thanks, Irene and team — I have the artifacts and the drive link. Quick read-through shows the summary metrics are helpful. Apr 23 15:00 PT works for our risk review team.

Action items on our side: we'll circulate the agenda to the risk committee and confirm attendee list by EOD Apr 20. If anything changes on Redwood's side (scope or agenda), please flag to me.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

— Lucia
Head of Vendor Risk | Everoak Financial
